decision: First execute cheap offline fixed640-entry global versus partitioned16-per-layer future-aware cache replay on saved data. No model/code integration. Sol owns separate global-cache-bound-20261002 directory.
provenance: Main selected an earlier saved Astra draft before its final rewrite. Sol was told explicitly that the offline scope stands. Final Astra selects in-path interval capture, retained as subsequent option.
qualifications: All parallel-metadata and prefetch rejection gates remain unchanged.
Global replay must reconstruct recorded slots and misses exactly before any comparison.
Use full current Top8 pins, same initial cache, demand loading only, no larger capacity.
Farthest-next-use counts under grouped pins must not be called mathematical optima without proof. A failed preliminary screen does not prove all global cache designs fail.
Opus standalone A/B/C is not selected: zero-byte paths omit checks; removing checks or bytes changes contention and memory state. Cross-arm subtraction cannot prove an additive critical-path cost.

Grok28-token teacher-forced union is not selected: known future token sequence is not live generation; union changes actual caching and may not preserve captured plans; added612MiB may threaten30% free-memory floor. Proposed1.6–1.8tokens/s ceiling is conditional, not measured or a hardware limit.
Any later protected-read interval capture needs unchanged workload and a separate observation-overhead gate. No new unit-test code for these experiments.
